fn Power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * Power(base, (exp - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (Power(0, 0) == 1)
  example (Power(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * Power(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn LeftShift(x1: List[Int], x2: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(x1) == len(x2))
  requires forall i in 0..len(x2): (x2[i] >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(x1))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (x1[i] * Power(2, x2[i])))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not (x2[i] == 0)) or (result[i] == x1[i]))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not (x1[i] == 0)) or (result[i] == 0))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not ((x1[i] > 0) and (x2[i] > 0))) or (result[i] > x1[i]))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not ((x1[i] < 0) and (x2[i] > 0))) or (result[i] < x1[i]))
  effects pure
  example (LeftShift([], []) == [])
{
  []
}
